summary: A handful of isolated complaints include one user calling out Reliance Jio app for failing to credit recharges after payment and another accusing Uber India drivers of illegally charging parking fees at Howrah station. News accounts shared specific cases like a Mulund man losing over ₹9 lakh in a Google Meet KYC scam and an Ambala man losing ₹14 lakh in a Telegram trading scam. A couple of mentions of BitBNS withdrawal issues and general insurance company gripes appeared but with minimal engagement or follow-up.
